as_told.title: Fire in the Sky: Hollywood replaced Travis Walton's real abduction

plain: Travis Walton says he was taken aboard a craft in Arizona in 1975, and the film version of his story, Fire in the Sky, is said to have changed what happened to him on purpose. Chris Ramsay, a YouTuber, tells Michels that the movie "played it out so differently": on screen, beings carry out a procedure on Walton and ignore his screams. Bryce Zabel, a TV writer and producer, passes on what Tracy Tormé, the film's screenwriter, told him. In Tormé's account, the studio said "the real story of Travis isn't good enough. You have to do a better abduction." Both men are repeating what others told them. If it is true, the frightening abduction most people remember came from Hollywood, not from Walton. Neither of them describes the real account in any more detail.
